entry_point: Sayuri Yukishiro.bat -> scripts/launcher.ps1 -> background core + scripts/tray.ps1

foundation.data_directory: project data/ by default; SAYURI_DATA_DIR relocates it; launcher falls back to LOCALAPPDATA on read-only media
foundation.sqlite_journal_policy: WAL on local disk; DELETE on removable, network and synced paths
foundation.web_shell: Python standard library HTTP server, loopback only

core.startup_policy: services start in registration order; failed startup rolls back every started service
core.shutdown_policy: reverse order; runtime endpoint and session row are always cleaned up
core.recovery_policy: restore context and next_action without automatic replay of arbitrary actions
core.health_policy: lightweight polling; SQLite quick_check only on deep status and diagnostics

update_protocol.sequence: task -> ID -> change -> check -> version -> journal -> commit -> next_action
update_protocol.publication: a finalized version is merged into main with fast-forward only and pushed, without asking

versioning_policy.rule: Every released project change increments the project version.
versioning_policy.module_versions: Each module owns an independent SemVer version.

next_action: v0.3.1: verify implementation commit in GitHub Actions on Windows and Linux; if green, finalize metadata, re-run CI, then fast-forward main. After that continue with v0.4.0 Module Runtime.

console.color_policy: terminal only; NO_COLOR and SAYURI_COLOR respected
console.ascii_fallback: stream encoding capability, -Ascii switch or SAYURI_ASCII
console.launcher_rendering: native PowerShell colors driven by --preflight --format json

tray.core_process: separate hidden process; launcher waits for endpoint.json from its own pid
tray.shutdown_policy: tokenized POST /api/shutdown; Kill only after a 15 second timeout
fallbacks: no Windows Forms -> core stays in the console window
tray failed to start -> hidden core is stopped, never left unattended
stale endpoint.json -> cleared by pid liveness check

update_service.source: configured upstream of the current branch, never a hardcoded origin/main
update_service.merge_policy: fast-forward only; diverged history is refused
update_service.backup: VERSION, PROJECT_STATE.json, UPDATE_IDS.json, UPDATE_LOG.md and the core database via sqlite backup; last 5 kept
update_service.verification: protocol validator, compileall and unittest in a separate process
update_service.rollback: reset to the recorded commit plus database restore from the backup
update_service.double_check: the source is re-verified before installation; if it moved, installation is refused
